narrative:
## Handover Summary — Impairment & Cost of Risk

Stage 1/2 model ECL, stage 3 provisions and overlays validated by portfolio.

## Key Decisions
• Stage 2 coverage on the four South East schemes raised from 2.4% to 3.1%
• Downside scenario weight 25% → 30%, shared with the NII and capital scenarios
• New South East development tranches paused pending monitoring-surveyor review

## Recommendation for Operating Costs
Impairment is the swing factor this year; the cost base is on track. Hand over to the cost-centre owners.

signals.title: Development finance stage 2 up from 9.8% to 16.4%
signals.excerpt: Four South East & East schemes (£52M) moved to stage 2 in Q3; FY2026 cost of risk forecast 30 bps vs 15 bps plan.
